name: Loa Shadowmore
source:
[i]"I've never played around. Each meeting is an earnest, fated love. The same goes for her..."[/i]

[i]Pure and Longing Brotherhood[/i]

A popular singer with a refreshingly bright smile.

As a member of "Shadowmore," he's charmed countless fans. His gorgeous appearance and elegant bearing has led to fans worshiping him as the "Prince."

Since he hits on women as easily as he breathes, he's often the talk of the town.
Maulo is his younger twin brother. Since they're fraternal twins, they look basically nothing alike.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=loa]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
